name: app-freelance-ai-agent-store-screenshots-in-bold-colour
title: Six vivid store screenshots for an AI expert marketplace with mixed colours and giant headlines
whatItIs: A 3x2 set of portrait screenshots in white, black and cream with bold headlines ('Earn money helping AI Agents', 'Just chat like Slack but Paid', 'Cash out the same day'), a black robot face, phone UI, an orange ring and a woman in orange glasses.
whatItMeans: Loud and playful; different backgrounds with one logo make the set feel like a campaign.
techniques: Give every screenshot a different bold background.
Add one 3D or photographic hero per card.
Keep the logo in a consistent spot.
bestFor: Marketplace and gig app store pages

vocabulary.definition: A row or grid of store images.
One large graphic on each screenshot.
